svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 17 October to 13 November 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 1010 contributions on 28 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
OCT 17 – NOV 13 · 1010 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 28 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST NOV 08 (149), IN VERMILION
